The supplied exact bindings establish violations for the action, effect, transition-guard, opaque transition-label, and Stopping-continuation dossiers; the containment dossier remains unresolved, and the Approaching progress dossier is not established because its exact state has outgoing transitions while the separate dead-end is Stopping.

issues.basis: NL3; source:state:EmergencyStopping; state:EmergencyStopping:line:28; inspection-equivalent state inventory has no action field.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping performs the Emergency Stop action.
issues.observed: EmergencyStopping is present, but no state lifecycle action is supplied for it.
issues.reason: The exact EmergencyStopping closed state exists, but the supplied parsed state inventory provides no lifecycle action for it. The required action is therefore absent from its exact carrier.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The text annotation "Emergency Stop" is present in the closed state name/body projection, but the supplied parsed action inventory does not treat that annotation as an executable lifecycle action.
issues.title: Missing Emergency Stop Action

issues.basis: NL3; source:state:EmergencyStopping; state:EmergencyStopping:line:28; closed event inventory and inspected state data show no outgoing state effect.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping sends the Obstacle Detected signal.
issues.observed: The Obstacle Detected event is declared and consumed as an incoming trigger, but EmergencyStopping has no supplied outgoing effect.
issues.reason: The exact EmergencyStopping state is present, but no state effect or emission is supplied for it. The observed Obstacle Detected event is only a trigger on incoming transitions and does not establish the required outgoing state effect.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The event declaration and incoming consumer transitions could be mistaken for emission, but the supplied typed facts distinguish triggers from state effects.
issues.title: Missing Obstacle Detected Effect

issues.basis: NL8; source:state:InMotion.Accelerating; state:Accelerating:line:11; inspected state inventory lists no action field.
issues.observed: Accelerating has no supplied entry action.
issues.reason: Accelerating and the required entry phase are exact, but the closed state inventory contains no lifecycle action. The textual body annotation is not a parsed executable action carrier.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed state body includes a projection annotation containing the source body text, but no typed lifecycle action is present in the closed model.
issues.title: Missing Accelerating Entry Action

issues.basis: NL9; source:state:InMotion.Approaching; state:Approaching:line:13; inspected state inventory has no effect field.
issues.observed: Approaching has no supplied state effect emitting Send.
issues.reason: Approaching is exactly bound, but its closed state has no supplied effect. Its incoming exit/Send trigger and outgoing transition effects do not establish a state-level Send emission.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The transition trigger named exit_Send is an incoming event, not proof that the state emits Send as an effect.
issues.title: Missing Approaching Send Effect

issues.basis: The deterministic deadlock fact is state:Stopping:line:27 with outgoing_count 0; NL9 requires progress specifically for Approaching, while Approaching has outgoing transitions. No candidate is emitted because contract locus/property preservation forbids rebinding the issue to Stopping.
issues.expected: Approaching continues to approach the destination without a dead-end.
issues.observed: Approaching has outgoing transitions; the separate reachable Stopping state is the only reported leaf without outgoing transitions.
issues.reason: The supplied deterministic frontier identifies reachable Stopping as a leaf with no outgoing FCSTM transition. This does not refute Approaching's own outgoing continuation, but it exposes a separate operational dead-end in the required InMotion response path; the existing NL9 progress contract is the closest explicit progress obligation and remains centered on Approaching, so no candidate is emitted against it.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact required Approaching state is operationally continued by transitions to completion, so the Stopping leaf cannot be attributed to Approaching's local progress contract.
issues.title: Stopping Has No Operational Continuation

issues.basis: NL10 requires state retention over a named window. The available deterministic facts establish reachability and outgoing transitions but contain no bounded trace or exact retention counterexample for the specified window.
issues.expected: Approaching remains active during the nearing-destination window until the specified stopping or deceleration condition.
issues.observed: Approaching is declared and reachable, with outgoing transitions, but no supplied trace fact evaluates retention over the NL10 window.
issues.reason: The supplied closure does not provide a scenario, stimulus, state-window trace, or finite trace counterexample for the retention interval. The model has an Approaching state and outgoing transitions, but endpoint topology alone cannot decide the stated temporal retention obligation.
issues.requirement_quote: The system remains in the Approaching substate while nearing the destination, until it is ready to stop or decelerate.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The presence of Approaching and its outgoing transitions is compatible with retention and does not prove a violation; a bounded trace would be needed to decide the interval property.
issues.title: Retention window lacks a deciding trace
